title: Domestic returns
text: Domestic customers may return unused items within thirty days of delivery. A receipt is required.

title: International returns
text: International customers have fourteen days after delivery to return unused items. Return postage is paid by the customer.

title: Refund processing
text: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within five business days after the warehouse approves the returned item.

title: Domestic delivery
text: Standard domestic delivery takes three to five business days. Express domestic delivery takes one business day.

title: International delivery
text: International delivery normally takes ten to twenty business days. Customs inspection may add more time.

title: Domestic shipping fees
text: Domestic shipping is free when an order totals at least fifty dollars. Smaller domestic orders have a six dollar shipping charge.

title: Missing delivered parcels
text: If tracking says delivered but the parcel is missing, first check reception and neighbors. Contact support after twenty four hours.

title: Password recovery
text: To recover a forgotten password, request a reset link from the sign-in page. The link expires after fifteen minutes.

title: Two-factor recovery
text: If you lose your authenticator device, use a saved recovery code. If no code remains, contact the account verification team.

title: Changing account email
text: To change the account email address, open profile settings and confirm the change using a message sent to the old address.

title: Order cancellation
text: An order can be canceled from the order page until packing begins. Once packing starts, cancellation is unavailable.

title: Delivery address changes
text: The delivery address can be edited before a shipping label is created. After label creation, contact the carrier.

title: Battery storage
text: Store spare batteries in a cool dry place at about half charge. Keep terminals covered during transport.

title: Battery disposal
text: Damaged or swollen batteries must go to a certified battery recycling center. Never put them in household waste.

title: Support hours
text: Live support is available Monday through Friday from nine in the morning until five in the afternoon, local time.

title: Warranty coverage
text: The product warranty covers manufacturing defects for one year from purchase. Accidental damage and normal wear are excluded.
